st: Diamond Is Unbreakable: Shigechi's Harvest, Part 1
d: Josuke encounters a tiny Stand holding a coin and follows it to a new Stand user named Shigekiyo Yangyu, who sends his Stand to pick up all the loose change around town  Josuke comes up with a better use for Shigekiyo's Stand.

st: Diamond Is Unbreakable: Shigechi's Harvest, Part 2
d: Josuke and the others head to the bank with their lottery ticket, but the bank clerk suspects foul play since someone else's name and phone number are written on the back  when he decides to call the number, Josuke takes desperate action.

st: Diamond Is Unbreakable: Yukako Yamagishi Dreams of Cinderella
d: A depressed Yukako sees a mysterious shop called Salon Cinderella that creates faces to bring people fortune  she receives a new face that allows her to find love and discovers how well it works during a chance meeting with Koichi.

st: Diamond Is Unbreakable: Yoshikage Kira Just Wants to Live Quietly, Part 1
d: When Shigechi accidentally takes Kira's sandwich bag by mistake, Kira chases after him.

st: Diamond Is Unbreakable: Yoshikage Kira Just Wants to Live Quietly, Part 2
d: Yoshikage Kira tries to dispose of Shigechi when Shigechi discovers his secret  Shigechi fights back, but Kira's Stand, Deadly Queen, mortally wounds him  clinging to life, Shigechi tries to warn Josuke about Kira.

st: Diamond Is Unbreakable: Heart Attack, Part 1
d: Jotaro and Koichi try to track down the owner of the button and run into the murderer, Yoshikage Kira, and his Stand  Koichi ignores Jotaro's order and decides to face Kira on his own.

st: Diamond Is Unbreakable: Heart Attack, Part 2
d: Koichi manages to survive the battle with Heart Attack  when Kira shows up, Koichi attacks, but Kira has the upper hand and seeks payback for his humiliation.
Josuke and the others head to Kira's house to learn more about him  they make some creepy discoveries until a camera on Kira's desk suddenly takes a picture.

st: Diamond Is Unbreakable: Janken Boy Is Coming!
d: Yoshihiro steals the bow and arrow and looks for people to turn into Stand users to protect his son  Rohan looks for Kira, hoping to find him before he tries to kill off his new family  a strange boy interrupts Rohan and challenges him to a game.

st: Diamond Is Unbreakable: I'm an Alien
d: Kira, living as Kosaku Kawajiri, struggles to control his urge to kill, finally snapping when he sees Shinobu's neck  Josuke and Okuyasu encounter a strange person in the middle of a crop circle.

st: Diamond Is Unbreakable: Highway Go Go, Part 1
d: Rohan catches onto Josuke's attempt to cheat him at cee-lo, but when he can't prove it, he cuts off his own pinky and declares that he'll take Josuke's pinky too if he can figure out Josuke's trick.

st: Diamond Is Unbreakable: Highway Go Go, Part 2
d: Jotaro tries to find the mysterious footprint Stand's user, racing around on his motorcycle for a phone to call Koichi for help while the mysterious Stand continues to chase him.

st: Diamond Is Unbreakable: Cats Love Yoshikage Kira
d: Shinobu discovers a cat in the basement with a hole in its neck and inadvertently kills it in fright  a day after Kira buries the cat in their yard, a strange plant grows on the spot.

Yoshihiro finds Kira, still posing as Kawajiri, and sees through the disguise  he spots Hayato videotaping him and takes action, knowing the boy might lead Rohan and Jotaro to his son  Josuke and Okuyasu find a man living up on an unused pylon.

Architect Masazo Kinoto shows up at Rohan's house to calculate the estimate for the fire damage and restoration and Rohan can't help but wonder about Kinoto's odd obsession  Josuke fights Kanedaichi again to save a trapped Mikitaka.
